name: Pistachios (Roasted & Salted)

pros.title: portable and shelf-stable
pros.explanation: They are easy to keep around and need no preparation.

pros.title: roasted crunch makes a small serving satisfying
pros.explanation: The texture and flavour give this snack more staying power than many light packaged options.

pros.title: still resembles the food it came from
pros.explanation: Even roasted and salted, it remains closer to a whole food than most savoury snacks.

cons.title: the salt adds a sodium tradeoff
cons.explanation: This exact entry has 428 milligrams of sodium per 100 grams.

cons.title: handfuls add up quickly
cons.explanation: The dense, snackable format makes casual portions easy to overshoot.

cons.title: nut allergy rules them out for some people
cons.explanation: That is a hard practical limit, not a tiny downside.

sourceNotes: Production entry for shelled pistachio kernels, dry roasted with salt added, per 100g.
USDA FoodData Central supplies the canonical nutrient record.
